commands.name: search-pods
commands.summary: Search CocoaPods libraries by keyword. Returns name, version, summary, license, platforms, download counts and repo owner. Paginated, 20 per page.

commands.name: get-pod
commands.summary: Get one pod's detail page: version, metadata table (tests, language, license, release, SPM), first maintainer, Podfile line, podspec/GitHub links and README text.

commands.name: get-pod-changelog
commands.summary: Get a pod's CHANGELOG as rendered text. Some pods only contain a link to their GitHub releases (see first_link).

commands.name: list-owner-pods
commands.summary: List all pods maintained by an owner (numeric owner id from get-pod's maintainer_url), with summary, license and language.
